name: module-flag-e2e-dotdot-discriminator
body: The `..`-crossing-symlink CLI leg pins the CLI's canonicalisation through the recorded selection, not through admission: structfrontend's own `absolutize` already canonicalises module dirs, so `--module inner/link/../A` admitted `A`'s files before the fix too; pre-fix the two spellings recorded different selections (`→ STALE (differing: modules)`), post-fix both record one physical selection (`→ FRESH`). The lexically-normalising arms this fixes (TS/C#/SQL) are exercised only by e2e-full scenarios. Upgrade when a hermetic lexical-normalising arm exists (or structfrontend's absolutize fallback is removed), so the admission assertion alone discriminates.
